parameters.label: ABPI Code edition in force
parameters.source: ABPI news Sept 2024 per research report; fully in force 1 Jan 2025.

clauses.label: Description of the grant or donation
clauses.text: This agreement describes the [grant/donation] of [amount] to be provided by Halden Pharma Ltd to [Recipient] for [activity].

clauses.label: Objective and how it supports healthcare, research or education
clauses.text: The objective of this support is [objective]. It supports [healthcare / scientific research / education] by [explanation].

clauses.label: Parties and their roles
clauses.text: The parties are Halden Pharma Ltd and [Recipient legal name, charity or company number]. No other party has a role in decisions about the use of this support.

clauses.label: Acknowledgement apparent from the start
clauses.text: The Recipient will acknowledge Halden Pharma's support in all materials relating to the [activity], and the acknowledgement will be clear and apparent from the start, including on the first page or screen and in any invitation.

clauses.label: Disclosure UK
clauses.text: The Recipient acknowledges that the value of this support will be published on Disclosure UK and in Halden Pharma's annual disclosure.

disclosures.name: Disclosure UK (ABPI clause 28; patient organisations clause 29)
disclosures.deadline: 30 June for the prior calendar year

calendar.label: Disclosure UK publication of prior-year transfers of value

notes: pmcpa.org.uk was blocked. Clause numbers 8.3, 23, 23.2, 28 and 29 come from the research report, which cites the PMCPA interactive Code and case reports. A web search on 27 Oct 2026 returned the Moderna case PDF title and summary (breaches of 8.3, 23.2, 5.1) but not the clause text.
The exact wording a UK agreement must use for acknowledgement should be checked against clause 23.2 supplementary information and the two Roche case reports before Legal finalises the UK template.
Certification is held as the internal field uk.certificationRef (the final signatory's certificate reference) so the priorApproval check can run with the current engine.
